issue.title: Agents deck PNG goldens time out: spread_deck_sticky and left_right_search_committed never reach their deck state

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Both Agents-deck PNG nodes fail every run on master, independent of Plan Decisions work. Proposed by phase bead sase-1hi.10.7.4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 1): they failed identically before and after that phase's change (full monitored fix-tui-screenshots run tnqrv4ngx3k2, pre-change, plus targeted rerun b738053c322d4573a44c529237089be9, post-change), and the full run skipped them, so their goldens are unproven.

Re-reproduced by the sase-1hi.10.7 land agent on master 67df4cfba5 with a focused serial run (`.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -m visual -k "spread_deck_sticky or left_right_search_committed" tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_deck_blocks.py tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_decks.py`): 2 failed.

- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_deck_blocks.py::test_agents_deck_blocks_spread_deck_sticky_png_snapshot`: `AssertionError: Timed out after 15.00s waiting for Small session renders a spread deck` (tests/ace/tui/visual/_ace_png_snapshot_waits.py:42).
- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_decks.py::test_agents_decks_left_right_search_committed_png_snapshot`: `wait_for() timed out after 5.0s — predicate never returned True` (src/sase/ace/testing/wait.py:54).

Both time out waiting for an Agents deck layout state, which points to one deck-render or layout-selection change, not load. A fix must also refresh and inspect both goldens.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1hi.10.7.4 proposed these as pre-existing visual failures; the sase-1hi.10.7 land agent reproduced both on master and no task owns them.
